lines.text: David son of Jesse, anointed by the God of Jacob, speaks these as his last words.
David says the Spirit of the LORD spoke through him, and the Rock of Israel spoke to him.
God says the ruler who rules with a strong army is like morning light at a cloudless dawn.

wrong_details.true: with justice, in the fear of God

lines.text: David says God made an everlasting covenant with him and will bring about his full salvation and every desire.
David says the worthless are like chaff raked aside, and anyone touching them needs iron or a spear shaft.
